title: Laser Capture Microscopy Protocol
author: Saivageethi Nuthikattu
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zawf2fe

steps.title: Prepare Tissue for Sectioning
steps.instruction: Perform an RNA necropsy on tissue (e.g., mouse brain) under RNase-free conditions. Ensure tissue is not fixed.

substeps.instruction: Either mold tissue immediately and place the cryomold on dry ice, or flash freeze tissue and store at -80ºC for later cryomolding.

steps.title: Prepare Slides and Boxes
steps.instruction: Prepare RNase-free slide boxes and membrane slides before cryosectioning.

substeps.instruction: Spray slide boxes with RNase Away and rinse with nuclease-free water.
Place membrane slides in the oven at 175C for approximately one hour; do not leave them for an extended period.

steps.title: Cryosection Tissue
steps.instruction: Section tissue to 8 μm using an RNase-free cryostat.

substeps.instruction: Wipe the cryostat blade with RNase Away solution.
Keep slides in an RNase-free box until use.
Use an extra slide box within the cryostat to hold sectioned tissue to prevent RNA degradation.

steps.title: Store or Transport Slides
steps.instruction: Manage slides based on the timing of the LCM procedure.

substeps.instruction: If returning to the lab: cover sections with RNAlater®-ICE, remove excess, and store at -80ºC.
If going directly to LCM: keep slides on dry ice until ready for use.

steps.title: Initialize LCM Equipment
steps.instruction: Power on the system components and launch the software.

substeps.instruction: Turn on the computer, microscope, and laser (turn key clockwise or to the “|” position) in that order.
Open the 'Leica Laser Microdissection V 6.5 software'.

steps.title: Prepare Sample Slides
steps.instruction: Hydrate slides and configure software controls.

substeps.instruction: Pour nuclease-free water into a Coplin Jar and immerse 3-4 slides for 5 minutes.
In the software, open 'Microscope Control' (menu > options > microscope control) and 'Laser Control' (menu > laser > control).
Adjust laser amplitude and focus area as needed.

steps.title: Dehydrate Tissue
steps.instruction: Remove water from slides to ensure they are completely dry.

substeps.instruction: After 5 minutes, remove slides individually and gently tap on a Kimwipe to remove excess water.
Place slides into a glass slide box containing a small amount of desiccant at the bottom and close the lid.
Leave for 5-10 minutes until residual water is completely evaporated.
Periodically check for pooled water at the bottom edge and blot with a Kimwipe if necessary; do not touch the membrane area.

steps.title: Load Samples and Collection Tubes
steps.instruction: Set up the physical samples and the collection mechanism in the software.

substeps.instruction: Load slides into the program with the tissue/membrane side facing down.
Insert a nuclease-free 0.5 mL tube into the holder and pipette 50 mL of RNA extraction reagent into the tube cap.
Click 'Collector Device: Tube Caps' (bottom left), select the cap position, and name the sample.

steps.title: Scan Slide
steps.instruction: Generate a visual overview of the slide.

substeps.instruction: Click the slide holder (bottom middle) and select the slide to view.
Click 'Create Fast Overview' to generate a 1.25X scan of the entire slide.

steps.title: Calibrate Laser
steps.instruction: Calibrate the laser in a non-critical area of the tissue.

substeps.instruction: Select 'Draw and Cut' (upper right) and go to menu > laser > calibrate.
Move to an unimportant area of tissue.
The laser will make four cross (+) cuts; match the mouse cursor cross shape to each laser cut and click.

steps.title: Harvest Tissue
steps.instruction: Cut and collect the areas of interest.

substeps.instruction: Select 'Move and Cut' (upper right) and trace around the vessel.
Ensure the magnification is at least 20X cutting objective.
Harvest a minimum of approximately 25-30 vessels to achieve adequate yield for cDNA synthesis/qRT-PCR.

steps.title: Post-Harvest Storage and Shutdown
steps.instruction: Secure samples and power down the equipment.

substeps.instruction: Place labeled sample tubes on dry ice for transport back to the lab.
Shut down components in this order: laser, microscope, and computer.

steps.title: Final Processing
steps.instruction: Proceed with the RNA extraction and cDNA synthesis protocol or store samples at -80C.
